notes:
Topline: Evaluating Redwood Dedicated for a multi-tenant internal inference fabric. Primary goal is predictable latency under heavy concurrency and model-specific tuning across a mix of LLMs. Team is platform-heavy (SRE + ML infra).

Recent conversation highlights: 
- "We need p95 latency guarantees for 256-token chat responses under 800 concurrent users" — VP Eng.
- Interested in model pinning per route, autoscale + reserved pool hybrids, and deterministic fallbacks (smaller quantized variants) for heavy load windows.
- Security: VPC + customer KMS; must support SSO/SAML + audit trails for every inference request. Data residency: US-only for production.
- Cost sensitivity: willing to commit to 12mo reserved capacity if SLA and performance numbers validated.

Model preferences & tuning discussion snippets: 
- Primary models: Mistral-40B-instruct (fast cheap baseline), Llama2-70B-chat for high-quality outputs, experimental 128k-context research model (internal).
- Context length needs: 32k target for initial POC; interest in testing 128k for research tasks but not in scope for production yet.
- Quantization: want to evaluate FP16 baseline -> GPTQ-4bit (nf4 / q4_0) -> int8 (LLM.int8) profiles. Goal: match quality within 1-2% eval delta while reducing GPU footprint.
- Batching & KV cache: prefer continuous batching with prefix caching for session affinity; want to measure per-token cost delta when enabling KV cache across long-lived sessions.

SLA bullets (initial requests):
- p50/p95 latency targets: p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 600ms for 256-token responses on production pool (H100-backed).
- Throughput target: sustain 3M tokens/minute at peak (approx. 50k tokens/sec) across the reserved pool; burst capacity for 30% above baseline.
- Uptime: 99.95% monthly; credits tied to multi-hour outage windows and variable per minute SLA.

POC ask / what we must deliver: 
- Redwood to supply a dedicated pool spec (GPU type + node count) with predicted throughput and SLOs for each model/quantization profile. 
- On-prem/VPC deployment guide and timeline for infra access (they want staging in VPC by May 1).
- Perf results: 1) Mistral-40B q4 @ 8 nodes target 200 requests/s typical 32k context, 2) Llama2-70B fp16 & q4 baseline across 12 H100s to hit p95 targets.

Stakeholder quotes & shorthand: 
- "If Redwood can show 2x cost reduction vs our baseline with <1% quality loss, we will move dedicated to prod." — Head of ML.
- Legal wants standard maintenance windows documented; procurement wants explicit SLA credits table.

Other notes: 
- Mentioned wanting per-route cost telemetry in Console. 
- Interested in Optimize suggestions for batching thresholds and quantization recommendations tied to eval suites. 
- Risk: internal legal flagged on-prem install access — must provide hardened installer + clear rollback steps.
